level0-1.Page_1:
Today is my first day here,

but everything here feels wrong.

Nobody has tended the lawn in ages; the yard is covered in dead leaves.

There is howling everywhere outside.

I know for certain

no human could make a sound like that.

Luckily I have the seed packets I bought from Z-Tech,[[ColumnBreak]]and these modified seeds can withstand any danger.

Besides, I'm not alone.

I have a neighbor, and he even gave me a whole bag of seed packets.

I was wrong.

These things aren't ordinary zombies at all.

They're mutated zombies.

But only a few of them have mutated,

so I should be able to hold out.

level0-2.Page_1:
Today is my second day living here,

and things are getting stranger.

The Sunflowers are wearing eerie grins,

their mouths split wider than any normal plant's could be,

with dark red liquid dried on their faces.

The Sunflowers have mutated. Yesterday's zombie blood dripped onto their faces.[[ColumnBreak]]What on earth happened here?

Can I really survive this?

No, there's still hope.

I still have seeds for other plants.

There's no hope.

Damn it, the thing is contagious.

All I can do now is keep the plants apart and hope the ones I plant later aren't affected.

level0-3.Page_1:
It's already day three.

It's not just the zombies that have turned eerie.

At night there are all kinds of strange noises, and the plants are getting stranger and stranger.

Some grin so wide their mouths have split; some have blood pouring from their eyes.

They've gone mad. This is insane. First the zombies,[[ColumnBreak]]then the plants...

Who's next?

When I woke up this morning, the Peashooter was no longer a Peashooter...

Then am I... still me?

I don't dare look in the mirror. I just pretend nothing is wrong.

level0-4.Page_1:
Today is my fourth day trapped in this house.

A new monster has appeared. I'm not even sure it can be called a monster.

Something like this should be called an Eerie. Ever since I moved in,

one eerie thing has happened after another.

What happened to this town?

Why are paper effigies from the funeral shop showing up here?

Why is it staring at me?[[ColumnBreak]]Stop looking at me. What are you laughing at? Stop laughing!

I said stop laughing!

Only the dead need things like you!!

Why are there more and more paper people? My plants keep vanishing for no reason.

The paper people have almost covered my lawn.

At this point, I can't care about anything else.

I pulled out my lighter, set a wad of paper on fire and threw it, hitting the nearest paper person.

The world was finally quiet.

level0-5.Page_1:
This lawn is always so deathly silent. I stare out the window, my fingertips trembling.

Today it was the plants' turn to mutate. The Potato Mine reeks of blood. While checking the lawn,

I clearly heard that sound.

This is no Potato Mine.

God, what kind of creature is this?

Under its round skin are clumps of dark red, sticky flesh.

Fine veins crawl over its skin like a spider web, rising and falling slightly, as if it were breathing,

constantly making the wet, sticky sound of organs rubbing together.[[ColumnBreak]]A zombie stepped on it!

There was no violent explosion like I expected. I only heard a dull squelch,

like someone accidentally stepping on a balloon full of water.

Thick, dark red liquid splattered everywhere, and countless tiny chunks of flesh flew in all directions,

sticking to the zombies' rotting skin and writhing wildly.

Suddenly I understood:

these plants were never my weapons.

They lie in wait on the lawn to ambush zombies only to feed this land, which is slowly becoming a nest of flesh and blood.

level0-6.Page_1:
The Wall-nut is sick...

Very sick,

beyond saving.

Its body is covered in rotting flesh.

I don't know

whether this will

attract even stranger creatures.

My plants are leaving me,

and I can't do anything about it.[[ColumnBreak]]The Eerie has seeped

into every inch of this land.

Sooner or later

it will seep into me too.

When that day comes,

what should I do?

At least for now the Wall-nut is still doing its duty,

as if no eerie change had ever happened.

It stands on the lawn,
level0-6.Page_2:
same as always.

To keep from giving myself away,

I took out my eyeballs (crossed out)[[ColumnBreak]]eyes

and put them in my pocket,

pretending I can't see everything slowly turning eerie.

level0-7.Page_1:
Another new zombie showed up today.

How many is that now?

How many more will come?

It walks extremely slowly,

dragging its heavy, rotting body with every step.

Its flesh has rotted into a grayish dead white,

and its pitted wounds

ooze yellow-green pus[[ColumnBreak]]that hangs stickily off the bones.

Whenever it sways even slightly,

maggots come pattering down.

It...

It, this thing,

is a living bug nest!!!

Why they appear,

I no longer want to know.

There are fewer and fewer normal plants

and more and more mutated zombies.
level0-7.Page_2:
I'm afraid I can't hold out much longer!

It's already day six.

......

......

What should I write?

Despair,

or...[[ColumnBreak]]Heh.

Demons and monsters!

I look at the Doom-shroom in my hand.

If all else fails,

I won't mind destroying this place myself!

level0-8.Page_1:
The Chomper has mutated.

Sharp fangs have grown out of it,

its leaves have turned withered and yellow,

and it looks like a twisted monster.

The way it looks at people is no longer murderous —

instead it's full of greed.

It craves every scrap of flesh and blood.

Its appetite has grown.

The old Chomper[[ColumnBreak]]took a long time to digest a zombie

and could only eat one at a time.

But now the mutated Chomper

can swallow two at once

and digests much faster.

It keeps craving flesh,

endlessly,

wanting more and more.

Desire drives it to devour,
level0-8.Page_2:
and turned it into a monster of greed.

...

It's terrifying.

I hurried to take the meat out of the fridge

and hurled it into the backyard

so the Chomper wouldn't smell it

and break into my house.[[ColumnBreak]]Let them tear each other apart.

The rest of the plants will protect me.

......

They should protect me,

as long as they haven't mutated.

...

level0-9.Page_1:
It's so cold.

Why is it so cold?

When I woke up,

the whole room was covered in frost.

Even the ink in my pen

for writing this diary froze.[[ColumnBreak]]Writing feels strangely sticky.

I feel like I can't go on like this,

so I put down my pen

to look for the source of this.
level0-9.Page_2:
I'm back.

Nothing serious.

The fridge's cooling just had a little problem.

I replaced its core and it's fixed.

The head I twisted off can be used as fertilizer

to feed the plants that are still fine.[[ColumnBreak]]These eerie things...

your good days are numbered.

The help I requested will arrive soon,

and not one of you will get away.
level0-9.Page_3:
Just a few lines later,

the cold is seeping out again.

The cooling unit is getting harder to control.

Looks like it needs a major repair[[ColumnBreak]]and a brand-new cooler.

Then again,

the cooling keeps getting better and better.

level0-10.Page_1:
The lawn seems normal today.

The plants are still eerie,

but the zombies are much friendlier,

at least they're not twisted flesh monsters anymore.

Everything is getting better.[[ColumnBreak]]I don't have to hide my eyes anymore

and pretend I can't see everything getting worse.

The agreed day is getting closer.

It's all almost over!
level0-10.Page_2:
I dug the car keys out of the drawer

and put them on the desk

so I won't lose them when we evacuate.

The lawn is quiet.

It seems even the zombies have gone to rest.[[ColumnBreak]]I glanced out the window.

Zombies are still wandering in the distance.

Then why aren't my plants attacking?
level0-10.Page_3:
The zombies stepping onto the lawn

are off in every way.

Something is very wrong.

They seem to be missing some detail.

They try hard to imitate,

I've heard of fake humans, but never fake zombies.[[ColumnBreak]]Why would they disguise themselves

as a body that's long been dead?

Can't they even manage to imitate humans?

Thinking about it, I couldn't help laughing at them.

I laughed so hard my jaw fell off.

It took several tries to put it back on.

level0-11.Page_1:

beyond anything I could imagine.

If ash plants aren't safe anymore,

level0-11.Page_2:
Thank goodness help is still coming.

I heard the news over the radio.

They'll be here soon.

The company's power[[ColumnBreak]]is beyond anything this land can imagine.

Everything here will be finished.

why

why won't it connect,

why won't it connect,

why?

why?

why?

why?

why?

why?

why?[[ColumnBreak]]Why won't you answer the phone?

level0-12.Page_1:

level0-12.Page_3:
No, you can't do this!

I'm going,[[ColumnBreak]]I'm getting out of here!

level0-13.Page_2:

level0-13.Page_3:

level0-14.Page_2:

My head feels clearer and clearer now.[[ColumnBreak]]My hearing is so good I can make out the telegrams.

The company's help is getting closer.

level0-15.Page_1:

level0-15.Page_2:

level0-15.Page_3:

Their blurry shoulders carry twisted, bulging growths.

Every step they take makes the ground tremble slightly.

feels like it's mocking my ignorance.

level0-16.Page_1:

level0-16.Page_2:

crushes my hopes,

tramples my sincerity,

level0-16.Page_3:
